headline: Minister Bayraktar: "Natural gas needs of 8 million homes will be met from our Sakarya Gas Field"
summary: Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said Türkiye became a partner in Kirkuk oil fields for the first time in about 100 years. He cited about 3 billion barrels of reserves, valued at 250 billion dollars.
why: Turkish energy policy aims to reduce import dependence, and access to Iraqi reserves and domestic gas supply shape the country's energy costs and trade balance.
